judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the planning/red-bar phase and never actually implemented the fix. While it added a `.lore/dod.md` file and an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSessionThrows.acceptance.test.ts`), it did not touch `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block. Because the production code is unchanged, the newly added acceptance tests fail, violating the test-passing requirement and leaving the bug unfixed. Furthermore, neither `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` nor `CHANGELOG.md` was updated as required by the acceptance criteria.
